purpose: Issue #75 bot-difficulty proposal with a near-Medium Easy policy
method: Fixed deterministic comparison seeds; each seed is used once per run. Difficulty assignments rotate across table seats. Same rules, resources and legal actions for every difficulty. Easy policy decisions were specified before running this comparison, without tuning to win rates.

results.config: 3 bots (levels rotate across seats), 60-round limit, 3 seeded festivals; reference grid and fees
results.assertions: All games terminated; per-event money conservation, event replay, card conservation, ownership and legal decisions passed
results.note: Reference rules have no Landmark; compare round-limit rate, bankruptcies and turnPositionWins with the prototype run

interpretation: Three players: Easy wins 29.1%, Medium 30.9%, Hard 40%. Easy remains close to Medium while constructing and buying out.
Four players: Easy wins 21%, Hard 29%, compared with 25% per Medium seat (two Medium opponents). The 200-game sample is small and does not guarantee a ranking.
limits: These seeded bot-only matches use a 60-round cap and the default reference rules. They do not measure strength against humans, all custom settings or a guaranteed ordering in every match. Policies only inspect public state; dice and Chance rules remain unchanged.
